records.plant_name: Alliance Cloud Services Dowagiac data center gas plant
records.monitor_reason: A data center in Dowagiac plans about 40 MW of on-site gas generation. Gas-fired data center plants stay on the watch list until a reviewer promotes them.

verifications.note: Names Dowagiac and 40MW of behind-the-meter gas.

records.researcher_notes: A DatacenterDynamics article at https://datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/hyperscale-data-to-expand-michigan-data-center-to-340mw-with-40mw-behind-the-meter-gas-deal says Hyperscale Data plans to grow its Alliance Cloud Services data center in Dowagiac, Michigan to 340 MW. About 40 MW would come from gas generation on site, with gas from SEMCO Energy, and the rest from the grid. The site is 413 East Prairie Ronde Street, Dowagiac, Cass County, state air source B1557, at latitude 41.990967 and longitude -86.100545. Its state air permit to install covers nine 2,000 kW diesel emergency generators. No air permit for gas turbines or engines was found yet. 40 MW is under the 50 MW threshold unless it is an engine or aeroderivative set that grows. Not found: the generator type, maker, number of units and start date.
